listening_ip.description: Primary IP address for listening (use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4, or :: for all IPv6).

alt_listening_ips.description: Additional IP addresses to listen on (e.g., multiple NIC IPs).

tls_listening_port.description: TLS (DTLS) listening port (standard secure TURN port).

use_auth_secret.description: Enable time-limited HTTP auth secret (recommended over static credentials).

auth_secret.description: Shared secret for short-term credential generation (e.g., generated per session).

users.description: Static username:password credentials (only used if use_auth_secret is false).

relay_address.description: IP address used for relay (if not using multiple relay addresses).

relay_addresses.description: IP addresses to use for relay (e.g., multiple public IPs for load balancing).

external_ip.description: Single public IP to advertise in STUN/TURN responses (e.g., when NAT is involved).

alt_external_ips.description: Multiple public IPs to advertise (e.g., for failover or load balancing).

allow_loopback_peers.description: Allow peers from loopback addresses (e.g., 127.0.0.1) — useful for testing.

deny_private_ranges.description: Block relay of private IP ranges (e.g., RFC1918) — recommended for security.

cipher_list.description: Custom TLS cipher list (colon-separated); leave empty to use system defaults.

log_file.description: Optional file path to write logs (instead of stdout/stderr).

total_quota.description: Total number of peer connections allowed per user (0 = unlimited).

pkey.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format; if not embedded in cert).

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for client verification (optional).

extra_options.description: List of additional configuration flags (one per string), e.g., ['no-udp', 'no-tcp'].
